CPV.note: Mindelo data centre was still to be equipped at opening; the Praia one is named only as existing; renting to others is not stated for either.
Mindelo data centre is not yet in service; for-hire status not stated.

facts.fact: Inforpress reports the Cabo Verde Technology Park in Mindelo, financed by the African Development Bank, was inaugurated on 6 May 2025 with parts unfinished, and the Prime Minister said conditions are in place for it to start operating, with VisionWare to be the first to set up there.
